sentence: The Panel is concerned that, in addition to illicit transfers from regional civilian markets, national stockpiles constitute an important source of materiel for gangs, with diversions from Haitian and Dominican Republic stockpiles confirmed during the reporting period.

Following the seizure in Haiti, the Government of the Dominican Republic launched an official investigation, and the Dominican National Police conducted an inventory of its armoury in October 2024.59 This shed light on the diversion of 908,001 items, mostly ammunition, from the Police stockpile, including more than 489,000 rounds of 9 mm ammunition, 230,000 of 5.56 x 45 mm and 26,000 of 7.62 x 39 mm, and 93,000 12-gauge shells.
